bosses.name: Rethilgore
bosses.general: The first worgen: Soul Drain on the tank. Easy.
bosses.dps: Burn him and free the prisoners after.

bosses.name: Razorclaw the Butcher
bosses.general: The kitchen worgen: hits hard and drains health. Easy with a good tank.
bosses.tank: Face him away from the group.

bosses.name: Baron Silverlaine
bosses.general: Veil of Shadow curses the tank (less healing) and he summons a worgen spirit.
bosses.tank: Pick up the worgen spirit when it appears.
bosses.healer: Mages and druids remove Veil of Shadow; heal through it otherwise.
bosses.dps: Kill the worgen spirit, then the baron.

bosses.name: Commander Springvale
bosses.general: Undead paladin with his servants: Holy Light on himself, Hammer of Justice stuns.
bosses.tank: Hold him and his Haunted Servitors.
bosses.healer: Expect a stun on the tank, heal ahead.

bosses.name: Odo the Blindwatcher
bosses.general: Howling Rage makes him faster and stronger the lower he gets.
bosses.healer: Damage on the tank rises as he drops: keep mana for the end.

bosses.name: Deathsworn Captain
bosses.tank: Face him away for the Cleave.

bosses.name: Fenrus the Devourer
bosses.general: Big wolf: Toxic Saliva poisons the tank. After he dies Arugal sends voidwalkers down the hall.
bosses.tank: Hold Fenrus; afterwards pull the voidwalkers one at a time.
bosses.healer: Cure the poison on the tank.
bosses.dps: Burn him, then the voidwalkers one by one.

bosses.name: Wolf Master Nandos
bosses.general: Comes with his worgs and wolves.
bosses.tank: Grab the wolves with him, an area threat helps.
bosses.healer: Several mobs on the tank: steady heals.
bosses.dps: Wolves first if they are loose, else Nandos.

bosses.name: Archmage Arugal
bosses.general: Teleports between the ledges, casts Void Bolt and curses one of us into a worgen that attacks the group. Thundershock hits the melee.
bosses.tank: Chase him to each spot he ports to; the cursed worgen may need controlling.
bosses.healer: Remove Arugal's Curse quickly (mages and druids), heal the Void Bolts.
bosses.dps: Interrupt Void Bolt, ranged keep hitting him wherever he blinks.
